a.description: Input array. Must be at least 2-dimensional.

offset.description: optional, default=0. Diagonal offset from the main diagonal. Must be a static integer value. Can be positive or negative.

axis1.description: optional, default=0. The first axis along which to take the diagonal.

axis2.description: optional, default=1. The second axis along which to take the diagonal.

output.description: A 1D array for 2D input, and in general a N-1 dimensional array for N-dimensional input.
